title: Senior Java AI Engineer
description:
**About Persistent**
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix
*®*
Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix
*®*
Assessment 2026.
  
  
**About Position**
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Java AI Engineer to design, develop, and deliver scalable enterprise applications powered by modern AI technologies. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, microservices architecture, and cloud-native development, along with hands-on experience integrating Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) into business applications. You will play a key role in building intelligent, secure, and high-performance solutions that leverage emerging AI technologies to drive business value.
  
  

* Role: Senior Java AI Engineer
* Location: Pune
* Experience: 8 to 10 Years
* Job Type: Full-Time Employment

**What You'll Do**

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications using Java, Spring Boot, and related technologies.
* Build scalable RESTful APIs and microservices following industry best practices and architectural standards.
* Design and implement cloud-native applications that support high availability, scalability, and performance.
* Develop and integrate AI-powered capabilities using Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and machine learning services.
* Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions and intelligent search capabilities.
* Implement prompt engineering strategies and AI orchestration workflows to improve application intelligence.
* Collaborate with architects, data scientists, product owners, DevOps teams, and QA teams to deliver innovative solutions.
* Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, architecture assessments, and sprint planning activities.
* Develop automated unit tests, integration tests, and performance validation processes.
* Optimize application performance, scalability, reliability, and security.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement long-term solutions.
* Support CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and cloud operations.
* Contribute to technical documentation, coding standards, reusable frameworks, and engineering best practices.
* Stay updated with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and software development methodologies.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* 8-10 years of experience in enterprise application development using Java technologies.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, and Hibernate.
* Extensive experience designing and developing REST APIs and Microservices-based applications.
* Strong knowledge of Object-Oriented Design principles, design patterns, and software engineering best practices.
* Hands-on experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Experience integrating AI services and frameworks such as Spring AI, LangChain4j, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or similar platforms.
* Experience building AI-enabled applications and intelligent business solutions.
* Strong knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, or similar technologies.
* Experience with cloud-native development on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Git, and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of application security, authentication, authorization, and secure coding practices.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and performance tuning.
* Strong analytical, debugging, problem-solving, and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to mentor team members and contribute to technical leadership initiatives.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment**
Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.
  
  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

title: Gen AI Engineer - Vice President
description:
**Overview of Citi:**
Citi is a world-leading global bank. We have approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 100 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. We provide consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. We enable clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting-edge ideas, best-in-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.
  
  
**Overview of the organization:**
The COO Enterprise Solution Engineering capability is responsible for the development of best-in-class technology platforms for Operations, including development of an integrated portfolio of Operations tools, end-to-end solution design for large scale transformation initiatives, design governance, and adoption of Generative AI solutions for driving operational efficiencies.
  
  
**Role**
:
  
  
This role is for an innovative Full Stack Engineer to help the build out of solutions that comprise of agentic flows & application integration, focusing on process efficiencies, automation, simplification, and risk reduction across enterprise business solutions. The successful candidate will contribute to the technical direction of products and services, instil engineering best practices, and promote cultural change within the organization. This position involves close collaboration with various technology teams to push the adoption of Generative AI technologies and agentic flows across enterprise-wide applications and processes, and to develop partnerships with third-party providers for validating and adopting best-of-breed solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Contribute significantly to engineering & delivery of end-to-end solutions.
* Adopt a product-focused approach, ensuring the development of robust, scalable, and user-friendly solutions.
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment by continuously testing, learning, and tackling cutting-edge problems.
* Actively engage in pair programming, promote lean methodologies, and streamline processes by removing unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Prioritize rapid delivery and iterative development, demonstrating adaptability and a willingness to pivot rather than pursuing a perfect upfront solution.
* Develop foundational components and mature technology capabilities in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Drive the enterprise-wide adoption and successful integration of Generative AI solutions.
* Demonstrate strong problem-solving capabilities and a proactive learning mindset, continuously acquiring new skills.
* Exhibit excellent communication and collaboration skills, effectively engaging with diverse stakeholders.
* Be adaptable and resourceful in navigating complex technical and organizational challenges

**Required Skills**
**Required Skills, Knowledge & Experience**

* Strong engineering experience with high-performance, large-scale distributed systems.
* Fluency in Java, Python or both.
* UI development skills with technologies such as React JS or StreamLit
* Experience with frameworks such as Spring (Boot, Core, JDBC, AI etc.) or Flask
* Proficiency in database technologies, such as Oracle, Postgres, or MongoDB.
* Experience designing and implementing REST or WebSocket APIs
* Experience with messaging and integration platforms like Kafka or JMS/MQ.
* Familiarity with one of the major cloud platforms including AWS, GCP, or Azure
* Strong knowledge of infrastructure tools, including Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Helm.
* Experience with build and deployment (CI/CD) tools such as Jenkins and Gradle.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Proficiency in Javascript/Typescript or Golang is also highly valued
* Understanding of Gen AI Engineering - LangChain, LangGraph, and MLFlow, LLMs, transformers, agentic frameworks, vector stores, and search algorithms.
* Experience using AI coding assistants such as CoPilot or Devin

**General Experience & Qualifications**
:
  
  

* A minimum of 10+ years of professional experience in financial services, technology firms, or dynamic start-up environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with Agile delivery, product management, and value stream methodologies.
* Proven track record in producing high-quality project artifacts.
* Demonstrated ability to drive the design, development & implementation of scalable systems.
* Motivated self-starter with the ability to quickly learn new skills and effectively navigate complex organizational structures.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or Engineering is required; a Master's degree is preferred.

title: Senior Analyst, VBA Automation (12 months Contract, India Based) : Contract extension possible based on performance
description:
**About Agoda**

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

**\*Contract extension possible based on performance, with additional benefits including a performance bonus and medical insurance\***

**The Opportunity:**

Are you passionate about engineering automation solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and control at scale? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, data-driven environment? Agoda’s Finance Operations Excellence is seeking a VBA Automation Specialist to serve as a hands-on technical expert focused on designing, developing, and maintaining automation solutions for finance operations. You will play a key role in building robust tools and workflow automations, modernizing manual processes, and enabling a more scalable and controlled operating model across Finance.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Automation Architecture & Development:**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain automation solutions using Advanced Excel, Macro/VBA, MS Access, SQL, Power Automate, FloQast, and Power Apps.
* Build reliable, scalable, and well-structured solutions with a strong focus on maintainability, performance, control, and user usability.

**Finance Operations Solution Engineering:**

* Partner with Finance operations teams to understand process requirements, identify technical solution options
* Engineer automations for high-volume and control-sensitive workflows across areas such as reconciliations, reporting, validation, close activities, and operational tracking.

**Data Processing & Logic Design:**

* Develop data models, query logic, input/output structures, and exception-handling routines using Excel, Access, and SQL.
* Optimize existing tools by improving logic design, reducing processing time, strengthening validation layers, and enhancing auditability.

**Workflow Automation & Systems Enablement:**

* Build and enhance workflow-based solutions using Power Automate, FloQast, and Power Apps to reduce manual handoffs, improve process standardization,
* Support stronger controls and transparency across finance operations.

**Technical Documentation & Change Control:**

Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation including solution design notes, process logic, code commenting, SOPs, testing evidence, version histories, and user guidance to ensure sustainable ownership and supportability.

**Issue Resolution & Continuous Improvement:**

* Troubleshoot defects, resolve production issues, support enhancement requests
* Proactively identify opportunities to refactor or upgrade existing automations.
* Contribute to improving development standards, documentation quality, and reusability of automation components.

**What You’ll Need to Succeed:**

**Technical & Functional Skills**

* Advanced proficiency in Excel, including complex formulas, structured models, large-volume data handling, and spreadsheet-based solution design.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Macro/VBA automation coding, including development of modular, maintainable, and well-documented solutions.
* Strong experience with MS Access and SQL for data storage, query development, data transformation, and reporting support.
* Hands-on experience in workflow automation tools such as Power Automate, FloQast, and Power Apps.
* Strong technical ability to convert business requirements into structured, reliable, and supportable automation solutions.
* Good understanding of process controls, exception handling, validation design, and documentation practices in an operations environment.
* Experience developing automation solutions in Finance operations environments is preferred.
* Python-based automation, Tableau/Power BI, and ERP scripting experience are not a must but good to have.

**Behavioral Attributes**

* Strong structured problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues logically and design practical technical solutions.
* Well organized with strong attention to detail, especially in code structure, testing, versioning, and documentation.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work directly with Finance operations end-users to gather requirements, explain solutions, and support adoption.
* Strong documentation discipline and a high standard for supportability, clarity, and technical quality.
* Self-starter with a hands-on engineering mindset and the ability to independently manage technical deliverables in a fast-paced environment.
* Adaptable, dependable, and comfortable balancing delivery speed with control and quality.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in automation development
  **is required (VBA and Power Automate are required), Good to have (SQL,Tableau, Power BI )**
* Experience in developing automations for Finance operations is preferred.
* Experience in a tech or e-commerce environment is an advantage.
* Professional certifications or training in automation, analytics, systems development, or process improvement are a plus.

title: Senior AIML Engineer
description:
**The Opportunity**
**Machine Learning Engineer/Data Scientist**
**Major Job Duties & Responsibilities (List in order of importance)**

* NLP Application Development: Design, develop, and deploy an intelligent chatbot/virtual assistant using state-of-the-art language models and NLP techniques. Ensure the application responds accurately to user queries and maintains context throughout the interaction.
* Working across client teams to develop and architect Generative AI solutions using ML and GenAI
* Developing and promoting standards across the community
* Evaluating and selecting appropriate AI tools and machine learning models for tasks, as well as building and training working versions of those models using Python and other open-source technologies
* Help democratize the AI building process while advancing the capabilities of autonomous and human-controlled agents.
* Setup and train large language models (BERT, GPT-3, etc.) and other state-of-the-art neural networks
* Data Preprocessing: Clean, structure, and preprocess raw data to make it suitable for use with NLP models. This includes text normalization, tokenization, and other data transformation techniques.
* Model Training and Validation: Train and fine-tune NLP models using appropriate datasets. Validate model performance using suitable metrics and techniques, adjusting model parameters as necessary to optimize performance.
* Integration: Work on integrating the NLP capabilities with various platforms including SAP, Salesforce, SharePoint, and ServiceNow. Ensure smooth and efficient data exchange between systems.
* Performance Optimization: Regularly monitor and evaluate the performance of the chatbot/virtual assistant. Use analytics to identify areas for improvement and optimize the system for better user experience and accuracy.
* Collaboration: Collaborate with other engineers, data scientists, and business analysts to understand requirements, refine models, and implement NLP solutions.
* Keeping Current with Industry Trends: Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in NLP, machine learning, and AI. Evaluate and adopt new technologies, tools, and methodologies as appropriate to improve our capabilities

**Qualifications (Education/Training, Experience & Certifications)**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* 7+ years of professional experience in NLP/LLM solutions, with a focus on developing chatbots/virtual assistants or similar applications
* 7 Years of experience in programming Python/R Proficiency in industry-leading NLP tools, libraries, and frameworks.

**Knowledge Skills & Abilities (Those necessary to perform the job competently)**

* Experience in deep learning and training LLMs.
* Expertise in programming languages commonly used in NLP, such as Python.
* Hands on experience with forecasting, predictive modelling, and classification.
* Hands on experience with AWS services, such as S3, EC2, SageMaker
* Exposure to Generative AI/OpenAI ChatGPT/LangChain
* Hands-on experience integrating with platforms like SAP, Salesforce, SharePoint, and ServiceNow is a strong advantage.
* Strong understanding of NLP concepts and techniques, such as tokenization, entity recognition, sentiment analysis, and language modelling.
* Strong understanding in building and maintaining API solutions.
* Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot technical challenges and develop effective solutions.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex NLP concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* A collaborative team player who can work effectively in cross-functional teams.

title: Sr. Martech Enterprise System Engineer
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
Avalara's Marketing Technology team is scaling its execution capabilities and expanding its AI capabilities to keep pace with a growing go-to-market engine. The systems that power campaign execution, lead lifecycle management, and marketing operations, Workfront, Marketo, and our leads pipeline, require strong, hands-on technical talent to build, maintain, and continuously improve them.
  
  
This IC4 MarTech Engineer role is for a strong technical leader who can transition marketing capabilities from a digital marketing paradigm to an agentic marketing approach by integrating, automating, and configuring new agentic models and solutions across our enterprise capabilities, building reliable integrations, automating marketing workflows, and ensuring lead data flows accurately from capture to CRM handoff.
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**

* Build and maintain integrations between Marketo, Salesforce CRM, Workfront, and adjacent MarTech systems, delivering reliable, well-documented solutions.
* Engineer and optimize the lead lifecycle from capture and enrichment through scoring, routing, and CRM handoff, reducing lead leakage and improving data accuracy across the pipeline.
* Develop and maintain automation for campaign operations, asset management workflows in Workfront, and lead management processes in Marketo, replacing manual effort with reliable, auditable automation.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions by working closely with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, and Sales Operations to understand needs and deliver working solutions on time.
* Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues across Workfront, Marketo, and the leads pipeline, performing root cause analysis and implementing fixes that prevent recurrence.
* Write clean, maintainable code and configurations following team standards for API design, data handling, error management, and security best practices.
* Contribute to technical documentation by keeping integration maps, data flow diagrams, and runbooks current so the team can operate and onboard efficiently.
* Support peers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and hands-on collaboration, raising the technical quality of the team's output.
* Monitor platform health and proactively flag performance issues, data anomalies, or integration failures before they impact marketing operations

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Qualifications**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in marketing technology, enterprise systems engineering, or a closely related technical discipline have recent hands-on work building AI/ML systems
* Solid hands-on experience with Marketo, including program setup, smart list logic, API integrations, lead lifecycle configuration, and data management.
* Hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront, including workflow configuration, template management, and automation for marketing or creative operations.
* Experience building and maintaining lead management pipelines, including capture, enrichment, deduplication, and scoring.
* Demonstrated production experience with LLMs, RAG pipelines, vector search/embeddings, or recommendation systems — not prototypes, but systems that served real traffic
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and JavaScript/Node.js, with experience owning AWS Lambda data pipelines from design to deployment.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and modern ML tooling (e.g., MLflow, SageMaker, or equivalents)

**Bar Raiser Expectations**
This role is a Bar Raiser hire. The successful candidate will:
  
  

* Hold themselves and others to high standards of technical quality, data integrity, and operational accountability
* Demonstrate strong judgment when making platform and technical tradeoffs, especially those that affect campaign performance, lead data quality, or system reliability.
* Raise the performance of those around them through mentorship, rigorous code reviews, and clear documentation.
* Simplify complexity, translating ambiguous marketing requirements into clean, maintainable technical solutions.
* Challenge assumptions respectfully and bring data into technical decisions.
* Leave every system, process, and team they touch stronger than they found it.

**AI Expectations**
Avalara is an AI-first company. This role is expected to be an
**AI Bar Raiser**
, not a casual user of AI tools, but someone who embeds AI into how MarTech work gets done and elevates the AI capability of the team.
  
  
**Specifically, This Role Is Expected To**

* Use AI to accelerate development and troubleshooting, including AI-assisted code generation, API debugging, and automated testing for MarTech integrations.
* Apply AI to lead intelligence, leveraging AI/ML-based lead scoring and intent signal processing to improve pipeline quality and Sales efficiency.
* Automate content and campaign operations using AI tools to reduce manual effort in asset creation, QA, and campaign setup within Marketo and Workfront.
* Identify and quantify AI-driven improvements, e.g., reduction in lead processing time, improvement in MQL-to-SQL conversion, or hours saved through intelligent workflow automation.
* Share AI best practices with the MarTech team and Marketing Operations, helping peers adopt AI tools responsibly and effectively.
* Apply AI responsibly, with awareness of data privacy, governance, and ethical use standards relevant to marketing data and customer information.

Candidates who cannot demonstrate specific, measurable AI impact in prior roles do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: AI Driven Drug Discovery Research Intern|M.Pharm Pharmaceutical Chemistry + M.Sc Bioinformatics|M.Pharm Pharmacology + M.Sc Biotechnology
description:

* Proficiency in scientific writing, documentation, and presentation of research findings.
* Pursuing or completed M.Pharm in Pharmaceutical Chemistry, M.Pharm in Pharmacology, M.Sc in Bioinformatics, or M.Sc in Biotechnology.
* For Pharmaceutical Chemistry/Bioinformatics candidates: knowledge of molecular docking, ligand analysis, protein preparation, and computational drug discovery.
* For Pharmacology/Biotechnology candidates: knowledge of disease mechanisms, ADMET concepts, biological plausibility, and drug safety.
* This is a six-month, remote, unpaid research internship.

—
  
  
**Experience: 6+yrs**
**Job Location : Pune**
***Summary**
:*
Makes our simulation products AI-accessible. Our products have rich programmatic surfaces — scripting APIs, file formats, data structures, workflow logic — that are powerful but not designed for AI consumption. This engineer defines the ontology schema that describes those surfaces, builds the knowledge graphs on top of them, and wraps them as structured, typed interfaces that AI agents can discover and invoke.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and maintain ontology schemas describing product capabilities, entities, and relationships
* Build and maintain knowledge graphs over product documentation, APIs, and simulation data
* Build structured tool interfaces exposing product capabilities to AI systems
* Write connectors to product APIs, parsers, and data access layers
* Implement retrieval and context layers over product knowledge
* Work with domain engineers to translate simulation workflows into discrete, callable operations
* Review product ontologies for agentic-readiness across 2–3 products

**Skills We Need**

* Strong Python; experience building and consuming REST APIs
* Familiarity with graph databases and/or ontology/semantic modeling (RDF, OWL, property graphs, or equivalent)
* Experience with at least one agent framework (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar)
* Understanding of how LLMs consume context and call tools
* Comfortable working within unfamiliar or undocumented codebases
* Systems thinker — able to decompose a complex legacy workflow into discrete, callable steps

**Nice To Have**
Vector databases; agent-tool interface development; parsing structured file formats; exposure to CAE/FEA/CFD, surrogate modeling, or physical AI.
  
  
*Deliberately not required:*
Deep simulation domain knowledge — domain engineers provide that. No PhD or ML research background.
  
  
**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

title: QA AIML Consultant
description:
Job Description: AI SDET Engineer
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced AI Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to define and advance quality engineering across web, API, mobile, cloud, and AI-enabled products. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep test automation expertise and can validate both deterministic software and probabilistic AI behavior. This role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Design, SRE, Security, and Data/ML teams to build quality into the full delivery lifecycle, improve release confidence, and lead the evolution of our testing strategy, tooling, and people.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end quality strategy, including risk-based test planning, requirement traceability, coverage analysis, test matrices, release-readiness criteria, and production validation.
* Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, mobile, integration, and end-to-end testing using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, and pytest.
* Establish maintainable test architecture through modular design, page or screen objects, reusable fixtures, parametrization, test-data management, and appropriate use of BDD, mocking, and stubbing.
* Define API and contract-testing practices for REST and GraphQL services using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or Karate, while promoting effective unit testing and close collaboration with developers.
* Automate test execution, reporting, quality gates, and deployment controls in Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps pipelines.
* Lead performance, load, reliability, resiliency, and security validation using tools such as k6, JMeter, or Gatling; incorporate chaos testing and OWASP-aligned security checks where appropriate.
* Use logs, traces, and metrics from platforms such as ELK, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, and Jaeger to diagnose failures, reproduce production issues, and drive root-cause analysis.
* Build automated evaluation harnesses and regression suites for machine-learning models, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation systems, and agentic workflows.
* Define quality KPIs and service expectations, including escape rate, flaky-test rate, automation effectiveness, mean time to detect, and release quality; communicate trends and corrective actions to stakeholders.
* Create effective defect triage and release-readiness processes, influence product and design decisions, and ensure quality risks are visible and acted upon.
* Protect personal and sensitive information through secure test-data generation, access controls, masking, redaction, retention practices, and GDPR/PII-aware validation.
* Mentor and lead QA and SDET engineers, contribute to hiring and onboarding, and strengthen engineering practices across distributed cross-functional teams.

**Core Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or an SDET role, with evidence of ownership of complex quality initiatives.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, C#, or JavaScript/TypeScript, supported by strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, networking, and operating-system fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience designing test frameworks and maintainable automation architecture with Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, pytest, or comparable tools.
* Strong knowledge of test design techniques, risk-based testing, integration and end-to-end strategy, TDD/ATDD practices, requirement traceability, coverage analysis, and test-matrix management.
* Experience testing REST and GraphQL APIs and service contracts with Postman, REST Assured, Karate, or equivalent tooling; ability to use mocks and stubs to isolate dependencies.
* Practical experience with load and performance testing, reliability or chaos testing, security-testing fundamentals, and OWASP principles.
* Experience integrating automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and working with Git, Docker, basic Kubernetes concepts, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills using logs, distributed traces, metrics, and production observability platforms.
* Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, influence decisions, and partner effectively with Development, SRE, Product, Design, Security, and Data/ML teams.
* Experience working with quality KPIs and SLAs, supporting release-readiness assessments, and participating in defect triage.
* Working knowledge of GDPR and PII obligations, including secure test-data creation, masking, redaction, and least-privilege access.

AI Testing Expertise
  
  

* Experience testing non-deterministic AI systems and translating product expectations into measurable evaluation criteria, representative datasets, scoring rubrics, statistical thresholds, and repeatable acceptance gates.
* Ability to evaluate large language model quality across correctness, groundedness, faithfulness, relevance, completeness, consistency, latency, token usage, cost, and failure behavior rather than relying on exact-match assertions alone.
* Hands-on understanding of retrieval-augmented generation testing, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval recall and ranking, context relevance, citation accuracy, answer groundedness, and stale or conflicting knowledge.
* Experience building golden datasets and regression suites; curating, labeling, versioning, and reviewing evaluation data while preventing leakage, contamination, duplication, and unrepresentative test coverage.
* Knowledge of adversarial and safety testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, indirect injection, sensitive-data disclosure, insecure tool use, hallucinations, harmful content, toxicity, bias, fairness, and model or agent misuse.
* Ability to test agentic and tool-calling workflows, including multi-step planning, permissions, memory and state, tool selection, retries, timeouts, partial failures, human approvals, and safe recovery.
* Experience validating model, prompt, retrieval, and configuration changes through versioned experiments, reproducible environments, baseline comparisons, confidence intervals, and controlled rollout or canary strategies.
* Understanding of model and data drift, feedback-loop risks, online quality monitoring, human-in-the-loop review, and production signals that detect degradation after release.
* Familiarity with AI evaluation and observability tools such as OpenAI Evals, promptfoo, Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith, Langfuse, MLflow, Weights & Biases, or equivalent frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI-specific privacy and security risks, including training-data exposure, model inversion, membership inference, prompt and response logging, retention controls, and safe use of synthetic data.

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Experience testing mobile, embedded, distributed, event-driven, or highly regulated systems.

title: Chief AI Architect
description:

The Chief AI Architect (CAIA) serves as the enterprise design authority for artificial intelligence at STERIS and leads the AI Center of Excellence (AI CoE) delivery organization, owning AI and agentic-AI architecture standards, solution reusability, technical-debt governance, and model/platform strategy end-to-end from proof-of-concept through production. Reporting to the Vice President & Chief Information Officer, the CAIA converts validated AI proof-of-concept value into governed, production-grade AI capability that supports the company growth strategy while managing regulatory and quality risk. As a peer to the Chief Enterprise Architect, the CAIA owns AI solution architecture, model strategy, and agentic-AI build decisions, while the Chief Enterprise Architect retains enterprise AI governance, policy, and audit-readiness oversight through the Architecture Review Board. The CAIA leads the AI CoE’s delivery pods (Product Management, POC, Development, and Operations) and drives a prioritized, value-scored AI project pipeline.
  
  
Duties
  
  

* AI CoE delivery leadership (20%). Lead the AI Center of Excellence delivery organization (Delivery Lead, AI Product Management, POC “Factory,” Development, and AI Command Center/Operations pods); sustain a governed, prioritized pipeline of active AI projects from proof-of-concept through production.
* AI production operations (10%). Own monitoring, drift detection, and incident response for live AI workloads (est. 8–12 today); ensure production AI meets enterprise reliability, security, and quality standards.
* Responsible-AI execution & governance partnership (10%). Partner with the Chief Enterprise Architect and AI Governance Steering Committee/Review Board to execute human-in-the-loop, fail-closed controls at the solution level; build to EU AI Act, FDA CSV/CSA (GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11) requirements as directed by governance.

* Talent, training & AI adoption (7%). Support the AI Enablement & Adoption Lead and AI Academy/Community programs; mentor AI Development and POC talent; build the CoE succession plan.

* Leadership: Provides strategic leadership and direction for the function, leading and developing high-performing teams, driving organizational priorities, fostering a culture of accountability and collaboration, and ensuring the successful execution of business objectives aligned with the company's long-term goals.

Education Degree
  
  
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or Engineering General
  
  
**Required Experience**

* 15 overall years of experience including: 8+ years in technology, 4+ years in AI/ML, data science, or enterprise architecture roles, and 2+ years leading an AI delivery function or team.

* Demonstrated success defining and executing enterprise-wide AI strategies aligned with business objectives and digital transformation goals.

You don't need to know every technology listed, but you should have a strong interest in AI engineering and practical experience with at least some of these tools.
  
  
**What You'll Explore**
We want you to understand how AI applications work beyond sending prompts to a model.
  
  

* LLM fundamentals: Tokens, context windows, structured outputs, latency, cost, and hallucinations.
* AI orchestration: Building workflows with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks.
* Context engineering: Managing what information the model receives, including retrieval, context selection, and context-window optimisation.
* Memory management: Maintaining conversational history, state, and relevant information across interactions without unbounded context growth.
* AI agents and tool calling: Connecting models to APIs, tools, and external systems.
* MCP: Understanding how models interact with external tools and services through the Model Context Protocol.
* Evaluation and debugging: Testing AI responses, identifying failure modes, and improving system reliability.
* RAG and retrieval: Working with external knowledge sources to generate more relevant responses.

**What We're Looking For**

* 0–1 year of experience in AI engineering, product development internship, or related projects.
* B.Tech in AI/ML or CSE.
* Good foundational knowledge of Python.
* Hands-on experience building at least one GenAI application, AI agent, chatbot, or LLM-powered workflow.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, or equivalent AI frameworks, with an understanding of LLM orchestration, context engineering, memory management, and tool calling.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs and databases.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Willingness to experiment, learn quickly, and explain your technical decisions.

We value practical implementation over certificates. Personal projects, hackathons, academic projects, and open-source contributions count. You should be able to explain what you built, how it works, and what you would improve.
  
  
**Good to Have**

* Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or semantic search.
* Exposure to multi-agent systems and workflow orchestration.
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, or Ragas.
* Basic React.js or frontend development experience.
* Familiarity with Git, Docker, cloud deployment, or CI/CD.
* Interest in Generative UI, AdTech, or MarTech.

**How We Work**
At Venxr, you'll work on real product challenges alongside the engineering and product teams. You'll have opportunities to experiment with new AI approaches, build prototypes, debug complex workflows, and contribute to features that can make their way into a live product.
  
  
We value curiosity, ownership, thoughtful problem-solving, collaboration, and a willingness to learn from failures.
  
  
We're looking for people who ask questions, take initiative, and enjoy turning ideas into working solutions.
  
  
**Selection Process**

* Technical screening: A 30-minute discussion about your projects, Python fundamentals, and GenAI concepts.
* Take-home assignment: Build a small LLM-powered workflow or agent. AI coding tools are welcome, but you must understand and explain your implementation.
* Technical interview: Walk us through your solution, design decisions, debugging approach, and potential improvements.
* Final round: Technical and managerial discussion.

**How To Apply**
Share your resume along with links to your GitHub, portfolio, or GenAI projects.

title: Data Architect
description:
**The Role**
We are building our enterprise data platform from the ground up and need a Data Architect to own it. This is a greenfield, hands-on leadership role — not a consulting engagement. You will define the architecture, make the
  
technology decisions, build the foundation, and be accountable for outcomes. You will report directly to the CTO and
  
partner closely with a Senior Data Engineer on the same hiring cycle. The platform will serve business analytics, operational reporting, and AI-driven capabilities across multiple markets andenterprise clients. A key deliverable is enabling AI applications and agents to consume trusted enterprise data securely viaAPIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  
  
**What You Will Own**
Data platform architecture — Data Lake, Lakehouse, semantic layers, and data consumption patterns across
  
structured, semi-structured, and event-based sources.
  
Ingestion and transformation pipelines — batch, streaming, and CDC-based, with proper orchestration, observability, and failure handling.
  
Data modelling — scalable analytical models covering core business domains: orders, inventory, fulfilment,
  
logistics, marketplaces, billing, and platform performance.
  
Business analytics — governed KPI definitions, dashboards, and self-service capabilities that replace manual
  
reporting.
  
AI data enablement — architecture for exposing authoritative, governed data to AI agents through MCP and APIs, with appropriate access controls and tenant isolation.
  
Data governance and compliance — data quality, lineage, PII classification, and controls that meet enterprise
  
security and privacy obligations across multiple jurisdictions.
  
Platform reliability — monitoring, SLAs, incident management, and operational runbooks so the platform runs as a
  
production service.
  
  
**What We Expect**
First 90 days: Weeks 1–4: Assess the data landscape, produce an enterprise architecture proposal.
  
Weeks 5–8: Deliver the first production pipeline and a priority BI dashboard.
  
Weeks 9–12: Define common KPI models for two business domains and deliver the first MCP-based data capability for an AI agent.
  
6–12 months: Production data platform operational with automated pipelines for priority datasets.
  
Governed business models and trusted KPI definitions in active use by the business.
  
Dashboards live and replacing manual reporting. Architecture for secure AI data consumption implemented, with initial MCP capabilities in production.
  
Platform operational practices — quality, lineage, monitoring, cost controls — established and running.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**
10+ years across data engineering, data platforms, or data architecture — with real architecture ownership, not just
  
delivery.
  
Proven experience designing and building enterprise Data Lake, Warehouse, or Lakehouse platforms.
  
Strong SQL, data modelling, pipeline design, and cloud-native (preferably AWS) skills.
  
Experience with governance, data quality, lineage, and compliance — including PII and privacy controls.
  
Hands-on enough to validate designs and build in the early phase; structured enough to define standards that
  
scale.
  
Experience in eCommerce, logistics, marketplace, or B2B SaaS is strongly preferred — the domain is complex and
  
ramp time matters.
  
  
**Desirable:**
Practical experience with MCP, LLM/AI integration, semantic layers, RAG, or secure enterprise data access for AI systems.
  
**The Opportunity**
This is a founding role. The data platform does not yet exist. You will define what good looks like at Anchanto — and build
  
it.
  
If you are energised by greenfield architecture, comfortable with high ownership, and capable of moving fluently from
  
business question to data pipeline to AI consumption — we want to talk.
  
  
  
Benefits

At Anchanto, we believe in creating an environment where people can build meaningful careers, continuously develop their capabilities and gain exposure to a truly global business.

* **Global Exposure:**

* **Comprehensive Leave Benefits:**

* **Recognition for Long-Term Contribution:**
  Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution.
* **Flexibility & Work-Life Balance:**
  A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities.

title: ML Operations Lead
description:
# Job Title: ML Operations Lead
  
  

* Experience:\*\* 18–25 Years overall
* Relevant Experience:\*\* 8+ years in ML, MLOps, or Data Science Engineering, including team leadership
* Location:\*\* Hinjewadi Phase 1, Pune
* Work Mode:\*\* 5 Days Work from Office
* Working Hours:\*\* 9 AM – 6 PM IST(870)
* Notice Period:\*\* Immediate Joiners to Serving Notice Period Candidates(only upto 30days)

## Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced ML Operations Lead to lead a team responsible for operating and maintaining traditional Machine Learning models in production. The role focuses on ensuring model accuracy, reliability, stability, auditability, and continuous performance through effective monitoring, drift detection, retraining, validation, deployment, and rollback practices.
  
  
The successful candidate will manage a team of two ML Operations Engineers in India and collaborate with international stakeholders, Data Engineering teams, and business teams to ensure timely and reliable model operations.
  
  

* Note:\*\* This is a classical MLOps role focused on traditional predictive ML models, not LLM/GenAI operations.

## Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop the ML Operations team, establishing operational standards, priorities, and best practices.
* Manage the deployment, monitoring, retraining, validation, and maintenance of traditional ML models in production.
* Establish model validation gates, including backtesting and champion-challenger approaches, before promoting models to production.
* Define and manage rollback procedures to restore previous stable model versions when required.
* Monitor data drift, feature drift, concept drift, and model performance degradation across the model portfolio.
* Define retraining triggers, thresholds, and processes to maintain model accuracy and reliability.
* Maintain model registries, version history, training data lineage, baseline metrics, and last-known-good model records.
* Track model performance using relevant metrics such as AUC, precision, recall, and other business-aligned KPIs.
* Monitor model bias and fairness, ensuring appropriate controls and human oversight for sensitive decision-making use cases.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to manage data quality, data freshness, data contracts, and upstream data changes.
* Implement business-requested model changes within agreed timelines while maintaining operational and validation standards.
* Coordinate with international stakeholders on deployment schedules, production incidents, change management, and operational standards.
* Report model health, deployment success rates, retraining outcomes, and overall portfolio performance.
* Support predictive ML use cases such as customer churn prediction, fraud detection, revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting.

##
**Must-Have Skills**

* Strong experience in \*\*MLOps and production ML operations\*\*.
* Hands-on experience deploying and operating traditional Machine Learning models in production.
* Strong understanding of \*\*customer churn prediction models\*\* and related predictive analytics use cases.
* Expertise in model deployment, model monitoring, drift detection, and model retraining.
* Experience implementing ML CI/CD pipelines, model registries, and model lineage.
* Practical experience with data drift, feature drift, concept drift, and model decay management.
* Experience with model validation, backtesting, and champion-challenger methodologies.
* Knowledge of model performance metrics, including AUC, precision, recall, and precision-recall evaluation.
* Experience leading teams, mentoring engineers, and managing operational priorities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including cross-border collaboration.
* Ability to translate business requirements into operational priorities and deliver model changes within agreed timelines.
* Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related discipline.

## Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Experience in telecommunications (telco) or large-scale data environments.
* Exposure to fraud detection, revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting models.
* Experience with cloud-based Machine Learning platforms.
* Postgraduate qualification in Machine Learning, AI, Statistics, or another quantitative discipline.
* Experience with model governance, auditability, responsible AI, bias monitoring, and model-risk management.

## Leadership Expectations
  
  

* Ability to lead a lean ML Operations team and establish scalable operating practices.
* Strong operational judgment and ownership of production model health.
* Effective coordination with business, data, and platform stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

## Candidate Requirements
  
  

* Minimum 2 years of stability in an organization.
* Immediate joiners and candidates currently serving notice are preferred.
* Candidates based in Pune are preferred.
* Willingness to work from the office five days a week in Hinjewadi Phase 1, Pune.
* Excellent communication skills are essential due to regular stakeholder and client interaction.

## Interview Process
  
  

* 2 Technical Rounds
* 1 Client Round
* HR Round

title: Software Solutions Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Software Solutions Engineer to support NVIDIA AI Enterprise customers and deployments across cloud and datacenter environments. This is a dual role: (1) Support, triage and resolve complex customer software issues end-to-end, and (2) build software features, automation, diagnostics, reproducible test cases, and deployment tooling—to improve product readiness and scale support across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work across compute and cloud-native technologies in CSP environments, including container platforms/orchestrators, enterprise system software, and GPU-accelerated AI frameworks and inference services used to run production AI workloads at scale. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with customers and internal engineering teams to understand issues, explain root causes, drive resolution, and collaborate on fixes and improvements. Success in this role requires strong debugging skills, crisp communication, and ownership of technically deep escalations from inception to closure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop and maintain product-facing features and deployment assets for AI Enterprise supportability (e.g., scripts, configuration guidance, Kubernetes manifests/Helm charts, and reproducible test cases)
* Develop and maintain Python-based tooling/automation (validators, log collectors, repro harnesses) to improve NVIDIA AI Enterprise deployment reliability across NGC and container orchestrators (e.g., Kubernetes)
* Contribute code-level fixes, patches, or pull requests (as appropriate) in collaboration with engineering to address customer-impacting issues and improve product readiness
* Support enterprise customers deploying NVIDIA AI Enterprise in datacenter and CSP environments, including Kubernetes-based and containerized production AI platforms
* Take ownership of customer issues from inception to resolution: reproduce in lab/cloud, collect diagnostics, provide mitigations, and partner with engineering on fixes
* Create high-quality bug reports and RFEs with clear repro steps, environment details (CSP/Kubernetes/GPU), impact analysis, and supporting artifacts
* Develop customer-facing and internal documentation (KBs, runbooks, deployment guidance) to improve time-to-value and reduce recurring issues
* Be on call one weekend per month in the event a customer has a Sev1 outage and requires engineering assistance

**What We Need To See**

* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* At least 5+ years system software development and troubleshooting experience, ideally with some customer facing
* Strong computer science fundamentals and programming/scripting skills (Python required; Bash; Go/C++ a plus) to automate investigations and build diagnostics/repro tools
* Strong troubleshooting fundamentals (networking, concurrency, OS concepts) and a structured approach to isolating issues across application, platform, and infrastructure layers
* Deep understanding of at least two of the following: data centers/servers, distributed systems, virtualization, deep learning frameworks, containers (Docker/Kubernetes), hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD for reliable deployments
* Familiarity with GPU-accelerated AI/ML stacks and production model deployment/serving (e.g., NGC containers, CUDA/tooling concepts, inference serving such as Triton or similar)
* Deep Linux knowledge and comfort troubleshooting in production Linux environments; working knowledge of Windows is a plus
* Professional-level communication skills, interpersonal skills with a passion to solve problems

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Hands-on experience deploying and operating NVIDIA AI Enterprise components in production across on-prem or CSP environments
* Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants/tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to accelerate debugging, automation, and test creation
* Experience operating Kubernetes-based platforms in production (cluster operations, upgrades, control-plane/data-plane failure modes)
* Strong performance debugging skills for GPU and cloud workloads (profiling, latency/throughput tuning) and familiarity with observability/tracing tools

title: Platform Engineering Lead- Data Services & Reporting
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly accomplished, hands-on
**SVP – Platform Engineering Lead**
to be based in Pune. In this critical engineering leadership role, you will provide engineering leadership, technical governance, and
**architectural alignment**
across our enterprise-wide
**Data and Reporting landscape**
.
  
  
This is a senior, highly technical engineering leadership and platform delivery role designed for a seasoned platform architect or software engineer. It is
**not**
a program management or PMO role. This position serves as a critical bridge that
**cuts across the entire data and reporting lifecycle**
—from raw data sources and federated query engines to the presentation, business intelligence, and AI-enabled experience layers.
  
  
You will hold
**complete design authority and technical governance**
over a platform that has a global footprint and affects business users and applications worldwide. You will be responsible for defining and driving our unified platform engineering strategy, standards, and best practices. Working in close partnership with our Enterprise Architecture teams and the wider department's AI design groups, you will lead the effort to rationalize our current platform landscape, ensuring that our data virtualization capabilities, APIs, and reporting engines are integrated into a cohesive, highly scalable, resilient, and sustainable end-to-end global ecosystem.
  
  
A core expectation of this role is the active adoption and promotion of generative AI tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and other developer productivity tools) to significantly accelerate software delivery, automate infrastructure-as-code, and elevate technical design quality across the entire data and reporting stack.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Cross-Cutting Platform Engineering Strategy & Alignment
* End-to-End Strategic Roadmap: Define and execute the long-term platform engineering strategy and technical roadmap that seamlessly integrates the enterprise Data Services and Reporting platforms, ensuring strict alignment with enterprise standards.
* Landscape Rationalization: Review, analyze, and hands-on rationalize the entire platform landscape—consolidating both backend data processing layers and frontend business intelligence/reporting inventories to eliminate redundant capabilities, reduce technical debt, and drive operational efficiency.
* Enterprise Architecture Partnership: Serve as the primary technical liaison with the broader Technology organization and Enterprise Architecture / Common Architecture Groups, partnering closely to translate enterprise-level blueprints into scalable, high-performance platform implementations.
* Unified Semantic & Metric Layer: Establish and enforce standards for a centralized, unified semantic layer that bridges federated query engines directly with BI platforms, ensuring consistent business metrics and a "single source of truth" from database to dashboard.
* AI-Accelerated Platform Delivery: Champion and drive the adoption of generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) across platform engineering teams to accelerate software development, automate schema and infrastructure-as-code generation, and streamline system refactoring.
* Platform AI Capabilities & Wider AI Alignment
* AI Capability Definition & Design: Actively work to define, architect, and design the core platform's AI and conversational query capabilities (including natural language interfaces and autonomous agent infrastructures).
* Departmental AI Coordination: Partner in close coordination with the wider department's AI architecture and design groups to ensure all conversational and agentic AI deliverables are seamlessly integrated, interoperable, and fully aligned with global AI patterns and security guardrails.
* Production Estate Management & Technical Debt Elimination
* Production Monitoring Standards: Enforce rigorous estate management standards by ensuring each application team designs and implements comprehensive, real-time production monitoring, observability, and alerting tools (e.g., Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics, or equivalent).
* Tech Debt Prevention: Proactively drive platform patterns that simplify operations, ensure ease of production estate management, and systematically eliminate and prevent the incurrence of technical debt across the application lifecycle.
* Data Virtualization & Federation Industrialization
* Query Federation Industrialization: Lead the enterprise-scale industrialization of our query federation and data virtualization capabilities, establishing logical data access patterns that allow real-time query execution across dozens of heterogeneous catalogs without physical data movement.
* Standardized APIs & Data Access Patterns: Design and implement standardized, highly secure APIs and reusable data access patterns (leveraging Java/Spring Boot frameworks) to support high-performance, real-time data consumption by downstream reporting and analytical engines.
* Centralized Security & Entitlements: Enforce robust governance controls, row/column-level data masking, and fine-grained access controls (e.g., Apache Ranger) across the virtualization layer to ensure secure data delivery to all reporting consumers.
* Reporting Platform & Experience Layer Integration
* Reporting Platform Architecture: Modernize the reporting and business intelligence infrastructure, ensuring that high-concurrency BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, custom web-based dashboards, and automated document generation engines like Aspose) are optimized to query virtualized data structures in real time.
* High-Throughput Performance Tuning: Optimize query performance and end-to-end latency across the entire stack—from the query federation engine down to the frontend visualization layer—enabling instant, interactive dashboards and conversational data search.
* Technical Leadership & Mentorship
* Technical Mentorship: Provide strong technical leadership, architectural guidance, and mentorship to a global team of platform engineers, data architects, and reporting developers.
* Culture of Innovation: Foster a high-performance engineering culture focused on automation, continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD), and modern platform engineering practices.

Technology Skills & Competencies
  
  
**Required Technical Skillsets (Must Be Hands-on)**

* Java Software Engineering (Core Competence): Advanced, hands-on expertise in Java and enterprise Java frameworks (specifically Spring Boot, Spring Framework, and Hibernate/JPA). Proven track record of architecting, reviewing, and governing high-performance backend microservices, robust platform integration layers, and custom API layers.
* Data Federation & Query Optimization (Required Concepts): Deep understanding of distributed query execution, query plans, pushdown optimization, and logical data fabric/data virtualization concepts.
* BI & Reporting Platform Engineering: Strong architectural knowledge of enterprise BI and reporting platforms (e.g., Tableau, custom JavaScript/React web dashboards, Aspose, or similar reporting and document generation engines).
* AI-Assisted Development (Must-Have): Proven capability and hands-on experience using generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) to accelerate software delivery, write platform code, generate tests, and optimize development workflows.
* Enterprise Architecture & Implementation Design: Proven track record of designing and implementing high-scale, distributed, and resilient enterprise architectures bridging data storage, virtualization, APIs, and reporting in alignment with enterprise standards.
* API Design & Governance: Strong expertise in designing standardized REST/gRPC APIs, microservices, and secure data access patterns.
* Database Engineering & Security: Deep knowledge of relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server), distributed storage systems, and centralized data access governance frameworks (e.g., Apache Ranger).

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skillsets**

* Agentic AI & LLM Engineering (Highly Preferred): Conceptual or hands-on experience with Agentic AI frameworks and libraries (such as LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, or equivalent) to design, architect, and orchestrate autonomous AI agents, prompt engineering pipelines, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
* Data Virtualization Platforms (Highly Preferred): Deep hands-on or design experience with query federation engines such as Starburst, Trino, Presto, Denodo, Dremio, AWS Athena, or Apache Drill.
* AI Platform Engineering & LLM Architecture: Conceptual or hands-on understanding of engineering platform infrastructure to support AI workloads, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), managing prompt engineering pipelines, vector databases, and deploying model hosting platforms.
* Modern Lakehouse Platforms: Experience working with cloud-native enterprise data lakehouse or warehouse platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent).
* Distributed Compute Engines: Familiarity with Apache Spark (PySpark, Spark SQL) or Apache Flink for large-scale data processing.
* CI/CD & DevOps: Hands-on experience with modern DevOps toolchains (Jenkins, Tekton, GitLab CI), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift), enterprise workload automation (Autosys), and automated infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible).
* Production Observability Tools: Experience implementing and utilizing monitoring and observability toolsets (specifically Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics, or similar) for enterprise-scale estate management.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Total Engineering Experience: Minimum 12-15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or data architecture within a large-scale, highly regulated environment (preferably financial services).
* Technical Leadership: Minimum 5+ years in a senior engineering leadership, principal architect, or platform tech lead role, with a proven track record of driving large-scale platform modernization, rationalization, and technical governance across both data and reporting systems.
* Agile Engineering: Experience driving technical delivery and architectural alignment within Scrum/Kanban frameworks, collaborating closely with engineering teams.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related engineering field.

title: BC Sector O And G-Cognite-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Cognite Solution Architect – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level - 15+**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.
* Establish deployment and environment-promotion practices using version control, automated validation and Cognite Toolkit.
* Review architecture changes, migration plans, integration code and performance bottlenecks; resolve cross-system design conflicts and mentor data engineering leads.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
